validator: SPIRV-Tools v2025.1, 2025-03-18, privately extracted verified Debian package

pr100_actual_module.result: PASS all three actual validator modes, including guarded fetches and structured control flow
pr100_actual_module.qualification: Validation does not prove correct GPU execution, complete scenery or absence of intermittent freeze.

structural_failure.diagnostic: OpImageTexelPointer result is pointer-to-u32 while cs_img0 is an OpTypeImage with sampled type float32 and R32f format. All three modes reject it.
structural_failure.source_evidence: Captured emit_spirv_atomic.cpp uses the integer fallback for ImageAtomicFMax32 when supports_image_fp32_atomic_min_max=false, but ImageResource.GetSharp retains the float image format. The actual prior game log reports shaderImageFloat32AtomicMinMax:0. The same fallback emits both integer atomics before OpSelect; selecting the result cannot select which side effect executed. Corresponding buffer fallback has the same eager-two-atomics defect.
structural_failure.scope: Actual generated module proves invalid type pairing. It does not isolate the cause of the frozen frame or identify the visible object. Profile-origin module source revision remains individually unverified beyond timestamp and recorded SHA.

feature_conditioned_failures.modes: Pass universal; fail Vulkan strict and scalar-layout modes
feature_conditioned_failures.qualification: Khronos maintenance8 explicitly permits Offset on sampling/fetch operations. The prior native game.log records Enabling extension:VK_KHR_maintenance8. The original audit omitted --allow-offset-texture-operand, so these three diagnostics must not automatically be called invalid for the actual device. Extension name alone is not the complete enabled-feature pNext proof; collect/review the native vk_instance.cpp feature chain and revalidate in a separately labelled maintenance8 mode. Do not drop offsets or change texture coordinates merely to silence the validator.

next_test: Implement separate integer alias metadata for emulated float image atomics so emitted image type and bound image view agree, and emit exactly one sign-selected atomic behind real branches for image/buffer fallback. Preserve normal floating image descriptors, guest bit patterns and accepted renderer/resource fixes. Bump shader metadata/binary versions. Run extracted-code and actual-module validation fixtures, then isolated native compile and bounded runtime. No new unrelated image modes or fake resource lengths.
history_reviewed: Previous PR100/99 native and validator-preparation records, shared query integration, exact current source and fork-main atomic fallback checked. This is distinct from prior explicit-LOD/finite-descriptor work and is not a previously rejected Linear8/readback/SRT experiment.
